Persona snap, never in a model
needs a new upstream snapd interface
exposes: interfaces the layer offers to the layers above, grouped by consumer
consumes: interfaces the layer plugs, grouped by provider
Red: new upstream snapd interface or ask. * = provider or consumer inferred, not stated in target-architecture.md. ↺ within layer: interfaces between snaps of the same layer.
The Driver assistant installs optional pc-kernel components (NVIDIA) after login, with admin consent.
Interface map: who exposes each interface (slot) and who plugs it
Rows expose the slot, columns plug it. Red = new upstream interface or ask. * = provider or consumer inferred, not stated in the doc.
· snapd's built-in slots: on Core the system exposes them implicitly. The Session snap's display-manager, user-session and document-portal plugs are super-privileged and store-gated.
· wayland, x11, desktop: upstream snapd has no built-in slot for them on Core, so the session snap must expose them (as Ubuntu Frame does). The prototype plugs wayland instead.
· The Driver assistant installs pc-kernel components and driver snaps through snapd; the target doc doesn't name its interface yet.
· Connections come only from store declarations: the stock pc gadget has no desktop connections (target-architecture §3.2).
